issues.title: build.zig event_store_mod fix creates second single-owner module conflict in bpm_src_mod
issues.introduced_by: commit 79335fc5 — fix(build): wire event_store into partition_maintenance_mod
issues.error: src\scheduler\partition_maintenance.zig:1:1: error: file exists in modules 'bpm' and 'event_store'
issues.root_cause: bpm.zig (bpm_src_mod root) imports event_store/store.zig via relative path (line 9), making store.zig owned by bpm_src_mod. event_store_mod also has store.zig as its root. partition_maintenance_mod depends on event_store_mod (from the fix). bpm_src_mod depends on partition_maintenance_mod. Zig 0.16 single-owner rule rejects: store.zig belongs to both bpm_src_mod and event_store_mod.

fix_required.description: Convert relative event_store imports in bpm_src_mod file tree to named module imports; add event_store_mod to bpm_src_mod .imports
